messages:
Hana (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding. Need IAM roles + SKU/package mapping + legal checklist. Can we align owners?
Mike (Product): I'm happy to own SKU mapping. I'll sketch packaging options today. Any constraints from legal or ops?
Lina (Legal): We need the publisher T&Cs, SOC doc links, and the EULA localization matrix. I'll list required artifacts by EOD.
Samir (Cloud Eng): For AWS we'll need the AMI IDs + IAM role ARNs. For GCP a service account + roles. Quick snippet for infra:
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "pub_api" {
  name = "redwood-pub-api-role-<env>"
}
```
Hana (Partnerships): Thanks — Mike, can you add a column for "requires customer-managed KMS"? Some customers will need that for Private offers.
Mike (Product): Yep, adding that. Also thinking trial footprint: 10k tokens/month free trial vs 14-day. Opinions?
Teresa (Ops): If trial includes dedicated capacity we need a quota gating flow. Prefer trial on hosted with caps, then upgrade to Dedicated.
Lina (Legal): Also note AWS private offers require a separate contract addendum. I'll prep a template and flag non-negotiables.
Samir (Cloud Eng): FYI — for GCP we have a quota project requirement. I'll open a ticket to request sample service account JSON and permissive roles.
Hana (Partnerships): Can everyone add a single owner in the tracker? Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/board/RED-123 (add watchers). :point_up:
DevEx Bot: Reminder: Marketplace docs draft available at https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace-onboarding — review by Thu.
Mike (Product): I'll draft packaging variants (essentials, standard, enterprise) and post by lunch.
Teresa (Ops): I'll coordinate staging accounts in AWS/GCP/Azure next week. Ping me with required roles by tomorrow.
Samir (Cloud Eng): Adding sample IAM ARNs to the tracker now.
Hana (Partnerships): Great progress. Next sync Friday 10am PT. If blockers, DM me. :thumbsup:
